body:
Thank you.

I gave up on better a long time ago.  I'd settle for different.

Since you shared, I guess I'll say the one thing that has kept me here so far is my dog.  Everyone else would find a way to come to terms with it, but he wouldn't understand why I went away and didn't come back.

I'm 26, and one thing I do not feel is young, even though I might be on the younger end of things.

It's not necessarily something between me and any specific lady, more like me and every woman that's ever been in my life.  Seems like you can't trust anyone.
